gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the lightest 2 kWh unit, the 35.7 lb Anker SOLIX S2000 at $649.99, ships 7-13 weeks after an order placed today on Anker's US store, while the next lightest ship in two weeks: Jackery Explorer 2000 v2 (39.5 lb, $999, by Dec 11) and Dabbsson 2000L (41 lb, $649, from Dec 10).
standout_why: Compared against powerbencher.com (cited), slopsheets.com, offgridbenchmark.com, powerstations.reviews and the Jackery store pages. Powerbencher lists four units with weights but no prices and no ship information. Slopsheets omits the S2000 and has no prices. Offgridbenchmark calls the Jackery the lightest at 39.5 lb and never mentions the S2000. Powerstations.reviews (in the results, not cited) comes closest: a priced table of about 22 units that flags the S2000 as 'pre-order only when checked Nov 17, 2026' at $699.99. It gives no ship window, not today's $649.99, and no ship dates for the Jackery or Dabbsson. So the whole-category price table is partly on a rival already; the dated ship windows side by side are new.
decides: By weight the S2000 still ranks first (35.7 lb, Anker's figure), ahead of the Jackery Explorer 2000 v2 (39.5 lb) and the Dabbsson 2000L (41 lb). Under the page's four-week rule it cannot be the pick: an order today ships between about Jan 15 and Feb 26, 2027 (7-13 weeks from Nov 27). The lightest 2,000 Wh unit that ships within four weeks is the Jackery Explorer 2000 v2, which also has 2,200 W against the S2000's 1,500 W. The Dabbsson 2000L, which we list through Amazon, is 1.5 lb heavier at $649 on its store or $615.00 on Amazon, so one of ours places in the top three either way. The Anker C2000 Gen 2 (41.7 lb) is also out for now at 6-12 weeks. I could not read Amazon's delivery date for the S2000 ($649.97) or stock at Micro Center, so whether another seller avoids the wait is open.
